shield one's eyes: When we stepped out of the dark theater, I raised my hand to shield my eyes from the bright sun.
我們走出黑暗的戲院時，我舉起手遮住眼睛擋住刺眼的陽光。
shield children from: Parents cannot shield children from every danger, but they can teach them how to stay safe.
父母無法保護孩子免受所有危險，但可以教他們如何保持安全。
shield someone from blame: The kind manager tried to shield his new assistant from blame for the mistake in the report.
好心的經理試著替他的新助理擋下報告錯誤的責備。
shield the economy: The government lowered taxes to shield the economy from the effects of the global crisis.
政府降低稅收來保護經濟免受全球危機的影響。
shift the blame: Instead of admitting his own mistake, he tried to shift the blame onto his coworkers.
他沒有承認自己的錯誤，反而試圖把責任推卸給同事。
shift one's position: After hearing the new evidence, the mayor shifted his position and decided to support the plan.
聽了新的證據之後，市長改變立場，決定支持這項計畫。
shift gears: After finishing my math homework, I shifted gears and started practicing the piano for my concert.
做完數學作業後，我轉換方向，開始為音樂會練習鋼琴。
the wind shifted: Just as we lit the campfire, the wind shifted and blew smoke right into our faces.
我們剛點起營火，風向就轉變了，把煙直接吹到我們臉上。
shift attention: The teacher told a funny story to shift attention away from the noise outside the classroom.
老師講了一個有趣的故事，把注意力從教室外的噪音轉移開。
shift responsibility: Some parents try to shift responsibility for their children's bad behavior to the school.
有些父母試圖把孩子不良行為的責任轉移給學校。
work shifts: My mother is a nurse, so she has to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
我媽媽是護理師，所以她必須輪班，包括夜班、週末和假日。
shine at math: My sister doesn't enjoy history, but she seems to shine at math and won a national contest.
我妹妹不喜歡歷史，但她似乎數學很出色，還贏得了全國比賽。
shine a light on: The new documentary will shine a light on the problem of plastic waste in our oceans.
這部新紀錄片將揭示我們海洋中塑膠垃圾的問題。
shine through: Even though she was nervous on stage, her talent and love for music began to shine through.
雖然她在台上很緊張，她的才華和對音樂的熱愛還是顯露了出來。
rise and shine: Rise and shine, kids! Breakfast is ready, and the school bus will come in twenty minutes.
起床了，孩子們！早餐準備好了，校車二十分鐘後就到。
take a shine to: Our new puppy seems to take a shine to my grandfather and follows him everywhere he goes.
我們的新小狗似乎喜歡上了我爺爺，他走到哪裡就跟到哪裡。
make hay while the sun shines: The weather is perfect for selling ice cream this week, so let's make hay while the sun shines.
這週的天氣非常適合賣冰淇淋，所以我們要把握時機。
ship goods: The online store ships goods to customers in over thirty countries by both sea and air.
這家網路商店透過海運和空運把貨物運送給三十多個國家的顧客。
ship out: All the orders you place before noon today will ship out tomorrow morning from our warehouse.
你今天中午前下的所有訂單，明天早上都會從我們的倉庫出貨。
ship off to boarding school: When he kept getting into trouble, his parents decided to ship him off to boarding school in England.
他一直惹麻煩，他的父母決定把他送去英國的寄宿學校。
the product ships next week: You can order the new phone online today, and the product ships next week to all stores.
你今天就可以在網路上訂購新手機，產品下週出貨到所有門市。
shock the nation: The news that the famous singer had been in a serious accident shocked the nation.
那位知名歌手發生嚴重車禍的消息震驚全國。
be shocked to hear: We were shocked to hear that our favorite teacher would leave the school at the end of the year.
聽到我們最喜歡的老師年底要離開學校，我們都很震驚。
shock someone into action: Only a terrible disaster seems able to shock the government into action on climate change.
似乎只有可怕的災難才能嚇得政府對氣候變遷採取行動。
culture shock: When she first moved to Japan for college, she experienced culture shock and missed home a lot.
她剛搬到日本讀大學時，經歷了文化衝擊，非常想家。
shoot a film: Next month the crew will shoot a film on this beach, so the area will be closed while the cameras roll.
下個月劇組將在這片海灘拍電影，所以拍攝期間這個區域會封閉。
shoot a question: After the speech, the host invited the students to shoot a question at the famous scientist.
演講結束後，主持人邀請學生們向那位知名科學家丟出問題。
shoot down a proposal: The boss is likely to shoot down any proposal that costs too much money or takes too long.
老闆很可能會否決任何太花錢或太花時間的提案。
shoot for the stars: My dad always tells me to shoot for the stars and never give up on my big dreams.
我爸爸總是告訴我要志向遠大，永遠不要放棄我的遠大夢想。
shoot oneself in the foot: If you argue with the interviewer, you will only shoot yourself in the foot and lose the job.
如果你和面試官爭論，只會害到自己，失去這份工作。
shoot the breeze: On summer evenings, my grandparents like to sit outside, drink tea, and shoot the breeze with their neighbors.
夏天傍晚，我爺爺奶奶喜歡坐在外面喝茶，和鄰居閒聊。
